svg.aria-label: Root locus of K times s plus 2 over s squared plus 2 s plus 2. Branches leave the complex poles minus 1 plus or minus j at 135 degrees and minus 135 degrees, curve round on a circle of radius root 2 centred on the zero at minus 2, meet on the real axis at the break-in point minus 3.41, then one goes to the zero at minus 2 and the other to minus infinity.
svg.title: Root locus of K times s plus 2 over s squared plus 2 s plus 2. Branches leave the complex poles minus 1 plus or minus j at 135 degrees and minus 135 degrees, curve round on a circle of radius root 2 centred on the zero at minus 2, meet on the real axis at the break-in point minus 3.41, then one goes to the zero at minus 2 and the other to minus infinity.

g.text: × poles at −1 ± j · ○ zero at −2 · departure angle 180° + 45° − 90° = 135°
